Glossary · Indian market

Pre-open session प्री-ओपन सेशन

The 9:00–9:15 am session in which orders are collected and matched to set a fair opening price before normal trading starts.

हिंदी में: प्री-ओपन सेशन

सुबह 9:00–9:15 का सेशन, जिसमें सामान्य ट्रेडिंग से पहले ऑर्डर जमा करके उचित शुरुआती कीमत तय की जाती है।

How it is used in the lessons

Pre-open session, 9:00 to 9:15 am: orders are collected for about eight minutes, then matched to find a fair opening price.

From Market Rules & Investor Protection

Pre-open session (around 9:00 to 9:08 for orders, then price discovery until 9:15): orders are collected and an opening price is set.
